name: Vitamin C effervescent tablet
identity: Vitamin C effervescent tablet dissolved in a glass of water, 240 mg to 1 g vitamin C with citric acid, bicarbonate and sweeteners; the dose is one tablet.
rule: Per 100 g of the product, each value is the median of the labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three declare it; a label states its nutrients per dose, so the file converts them with the dose's weight (the pack's net content divided by its count of tablets, capsules, sticks or drops, or the stated dose weight). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from dm.de, rossmann.de and shop-apotheke.com product pages.
